scope: Top-level events 79–88 in current EVENTS order
rules: Old GPX files remain valid until a new official GPX is published, downloaded, parsed and validated.
Never replace historical GPX solely because a new event edition is announced.
A course page or GPX button is not equivalent to a technically validated GPX binary.

events.name: Swiss Alps 100
events.note: Current official homepage lists 160K, 100K, 50K, Vertical, Kids and 2027-only Matterhorning. Older checkpoint omitted Vertical and Kids and described Matterhorning as 2027-only correctly. Official Matterhorning page provides a GPX download.

events.name: Allgäu Panorama Marathon
events.note: Official registration page confirms 7–8 August and seven formats including new reverse half marathon and 5K. Official schedule confirms starts; route metrics from registration listing. Keep GPX as not publicly available until organizer publishes a download.

events.name: Last Soul Ultra
events.note: Official Season 3/2027 page confirms 6.706 km loop, hourly starts and no fixed finish distance. World Series has USA, UK and Australia qualifiers and a Germany final in August; no confirmed exact date/venue or public GPX.

events.name: Karnisches Ungetüm
events.note: 2027 date and 80 km / 5,200 hm appear in current race-calendar reporting, while another listing has conflicting 74–75 km figures/date. Treat 2027 details as provisional pending organizer's own confirmation; do not change app metrics from secondary source.

events.name: TREK Matterhorn Ultraks
events.date: 2027 not confirmed on official course pages at audit time
events.note: Older checkpoint found current official pages/files marked 2026. No 2027 edition date or updated official GPX verified. Keep old files historical, not 2027.

events.name: Transalpine Run
events.note: 2027 event date reported as 18–24 September. Current public route page still contains 2026 stages; organizer FAQ says GPX files are provided to registered participants. Do not reuse 2026 stages as 2027.

events.name: HOKA UTMB Mont-Blanc
events.gpxStatus: 2027 event window known; final course files not yet verified
events.note: 2027 race week dates are listed as 23–29 August by current calendar source. Official 2027 route and GPX publication must be rechecked; do not treat 2026 route files as current.

events.name: Fränkischer Backyard Ultra
events.note: Official public information available in previous check was a 2026 announcement and 6.7 km loop. No 2027 date or current GPX confirmed. Do not carry 2026 file forward.

events.name: Dolomiti di Brenta Trail
events.date: 2027 date to be rechecked against organizer calendar
events.note: Organizer route pages document maps and GPS tracks but allow changes until 31 July 2027, when final official route is published. Import only final version after that date.

events.name: adidas TERREX INFINITE TRAILS Gastein
events.note: 2027 event listed for 4 September. Organizer's public GPX/racemap pack still identifies 2026; no 2027 track should be imported until updated Trailbook/course pack is published.
